newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Development Bank lowers prime lending rates.
newsitem.headline: Korea Development Bank lowers prime lending rates.

text.p: South Korea's state-run Korea Development Bank has lowered prime lending rates by 0.2 percentage point to 11.25 percent, the bank said on Monday.
It was the second time the bank has lowered its prime lending rates since it cut rates by 0.1 percentage point last month.
A bank official said the cut was in line with recently falling interest rates and aimed at boosting sluggish corporate facilities investment.
But prime rates for foreign currency loans in dollars and long-term loans in the local currency would remain unchanged at 7.70 percent and 10.90 percent respectively.
